## Never print in production

Use the `logging` module: leveled, configurable, and routable to files/services. Get a module-level logger with `logging.getLogger(__name__)`.

## Levels

`DEBUG < INFO < WARNING < ERROR < CRITICAL`. Configure once at startup with `basicConfig` or `dictConfig`; libraries should only emit, not configure.

## Structured logs

Emit key/value context (request id, user) for searchable logs. `logger.exception` inside an `except` captures the traceback.
